reply: rating term with linear T-dependence plus a power-law term, `(p0+p1*T)*(1-exp(-(p2+p3*T)*eps)) + p4*T^p5*eps^p6`, at NMSE 6.3e-3. A full polynomial in eps and T (degree 3) fits to about 1e-4 in relative error, but it is an empirical fit, not a closed-form law, and I did not submit it as a candidate.
